title: SCP Lockdown X Bare Bones
description: Branches Bare-Bones to Popular SCP Mod Lockdown!
body:
Hey! Thanks for Stopping By!

This is The first, (_And to my knowledge Only_) Resouce Pack that branches the Popular [**Bare Bones**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones) Resource Pack to The [**SCP Lockdown Mod!**](https://modrinth.com/mod/scp-lockdown) This is an in-Progress So not every Texture Is finished. **Please Don't Submit Any Requests for Textures.** It will All be done Eventually!

 

MAY Work on 1.12 Versions. I have not checked.
